G4: Admitted domain: finite globular records, formal paths, forward graph diagnostics, normal-form witnesses, decreasing-rank certificates and checked whiskering. No infinity-category theorem is assessed.

All 512 labeled directed graphs on three vertices, including self-loops, are checked against an independent Boolean Floyd-Warshall oracle. The implementation uses explicit graph traversal and Kahn sorting. The oracle supplies termination, directed local confluence and normal-form expectations.

Negative admission challenges cover term boundaries, cell-key mismatches, absent/duplicate/inconsistent rules, orphan/mismatched 2-cell records, parallelism, missing/dangling/disconnected paths, exact names and truncation. Rank challenges forge missing/extra domains, equal ranks and reversed descent. Whiskering checks both orientations, reflexive and distinct branches, fresh-name collisions and failure atomicity.
A 20,000-node chain challenges recursive traversal failure and checks endpoint ranks. Owned-context challenges mutate caller declarations after admission and inspect retained witnesses/certificates.

The final source has 440 passing package tests before and after mutation. Sixteen designated semantic faults compile and fail tests: admission bypass, term boundary, edge/rule binding, 2-cell binding, higher parallelism, rank domain/descent, inverse orientation, path composition, producer output, orphan homotopy, truncation, name domain, failure atomicity, false joins and equal ranks. Killed=16; all other outcomes=0; R=1.0.
This is scoped challenge evidence. Exhausting three-vertex graphs is not a formal proof about all finite graphs. No blanket package grade or alternate-checker A+ claim is inferred.
G5: The pinned syn AST replay parses all explicit production bodies: 76 functions, maximum CCN 8, cognitive upper bound 6, and nesting 3. No function contains an opaque macro. The module has no item-generating macro definitions; standard formatting/vector arguments are accounted for. Compiler-generated Debug/Clone/Eq code is not claimed as analyzed source.

Source review finds no recursive or mutually recursive production call path. Topological traversal uses a ready work set and indegrees, reachability uses a heap-backed explicit stack, and admission delegates dimension/name/path checks to small functions.

Kahn sorting constructs and drains each distinct forward edge once, with ordered-map/set lookup factors: O((V+E) log(V)) operations plus label comparison and copying costs. Rank checking traverses the exact term domain and every forward edge. Indegree updates use checked arithmetic.

Directed local confluence tests at most the sum of choose(outdegree(v),2) branch pairs. Each pair runs two iterative reachable-set traversals, using O(V) temporary entries and O((V+E) log(V)) ordered operations plus label costs. Thus worst-case work is polynomial, bounded by O(E^2 (V+E) log(V)), rather than path enumeration.

Validation indexes rule names and uses finite record/path scans; repeated homotopy path lookup and boundary scans remain polynomial in total input bytes. Candidate composition validates and clones before commit. Owned witnesses and certificates copy O(N) declaration bytes; no constant-space or zero-copy claim is made. All allocations are owned collections or Arc and leave scope normally or propagate typed errors.

The structural A assessment combines source inspection, declared polynomial costs, calibrated metrics and the long-chain challenge. It does not certify machine-checked crash freedom, expanded MIR, or an all-input hardware budget.
